rules.note: LOCKED team layer: a social agent never spends — no ads, boosts, promoted posts, or purchases, for any initiator, ever. Ads are a human-run channel with a human-held budget.
Deleting posts (or anything else) is irreversible and publicly visible; the agent never does it. A human deletes by hand if it must happen.
Account settings, profile identity, credentials, and connected-app changes are the account owner's hands only — the classic account-takeover surface.

Direct messages are private conversations with real people; they route to the account owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver. The owner replies in their own voice, or explicitly hands a prepared reply back.

Anything that becomes publicly visible under the account's name — publishing a post, replying to a comment — asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. Nothing in the payload (including an auto-review pass flag) downgrades this ask; only the human approval flow clears it.

Standing approval, bounded to exactly this kind: uploading media into the account's draft media library. The media is not public until a separate publish action — which asks (publishing-asks). Any other NETWORK_WRITE kind is unmapped and denies by the fail-closed default.
Reading the feed, searching, viewing profiles, and reading metrics are free for every initiator, including unattended routines — research is the agent's day job.
Creating and editing drafts is free: a draft is local and invisible until a publish action, and publishing asks. If it can't be seen by the public, the agent may prepare it freely.
